description: Who the firewall actually stopped: blocks (403), rate limits (429) and challenges, totalled per rule and per IP, plus the most recent hits. Use it to check that a new block or rate limit is working.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

from.description: Optional start time as ISO 8601 (instead of since).

ruleId.description: Optional rule id (rate limit, scoped block or challenge).

since.description: Look-back window, for example 30m, 6h or 7d (default 24h, max 30d).

name: securenow_firewall_hits
title: Firewall Hits
